title: The site agent changes an icon by picking one from Tracy's icon library and writing it into the icon slot and its other-theme twin
steps: S1: Run the icon door test: node --test --test-concurrency=1 apps/tracy-web/test/site-icon-door.test.mjs.
S2: Run the tool test and the surface test of the site tools one file at a time: packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/media-icon.test.mjs, then surface.test.mjs.
expect: S1: every test passes: a search answers library names and no brand logo; an icon slot names its twin from either side; a redrawn icon keeps the template's size and backing and the colours the slot shows now; an unknown name or an unreadable icon draws nothing; the door refuses a bad slot, an unknown operation and a site with no kit.

S2: every test passes: the tool draws the slot and its twin, uploads both files and writes both slots in one contract apply; a slot that is not an icon is sent to media.draw; a missing icon, an unknown name or a failed upload writes nothing; the contract surfaces offer media.icon and say an icon slot takes no drawing.
fence: Picking and drawing an icon for an icon slot pair, checked with invented kits and icon files and a fake Apply door
